units.source_text: 就连刚刚离开的驹子的房间，也好像已经属于很遥远的世界。

en.t: Even Komako's room, which he had just left, already seemed to belong to a very distant world.

units.source_text: 对于这种茫然的状态，连岛村也觉得愕然。

en.t: Even Shimamura himself was startled by this bewildered state.

units.source_text: 他爬到山坡上，一个按摩女就走了过来。

en.t: When he climbed up the slope, a blind masseuse came walking toward him.

units.source_text: 岛村好像抓住了什么东西似地喊道：

en.t: Shimamura called out as though he had caught hold of something.
